agent.problem: The stop gives the penalty of being cut off but never covers the rest of Numbers 9:13: this happens because the man did not present the LORD's offering at its appointed time, and he will bear the consequences of his sin. Those stated reasons and consequences are important to understanding the verse.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
